# Telix H1 2026 Results: Investor Webcast Notification


**Melbourne (Australia) and Indianapolis, IN (United States) | July 31, 2026**


Telix today advises that it will release its financial results for the half-year ended June 30, 2026 on Thursday August 20, 2026.


An investor webcast and conference call will be held at 9:00 a.m. AEST on Thursday August 20, 2026 (7:00 p.m. EDT Wednesday August 19, 2026).


Participants can register for the webcast or teleconference at the following link:[https://s1.c-conf.com/diamondpass/10056417-pz2402.html](https://s1.c-conf.com/diamondpass/10056417-pz2402.html)
